visualCharacteristics: Fixed-width container: left two-thirds is a 2-column grid of white game tiles with drop shadow (image top, optional orange 'NEW' corner flag or jackpot prize-bar overlay, grey title, description, green next-draw/jackpot text, full-width blue pill arrow button); right third is a stacked rail of 4 linked promo images.
contentPattern: Look-alike tiles that flow and wrap in a 2-column grid, each linking to a game/promo detail page; editorial item count varies, so Cards. 2-column shadowed game tiles with image overlay flag, draw info and full-width pill CTA; no existing cards variant
usage: Featured games and promotions grid (8 tiles) in a split section beside a right rail of promo images.
reuseGuidance: Use for shadowed game/promo tiles in a 2-column grid. One row per tile: cell 1 = tile image (optionally linked); cell 2 = optional short flag paragraph (e.g. NEW) before the title, heading, description paragraph, optional next-draw/jackpot paragraphs, CTA link as the last paragraph.

cells: Text: H3 title, description paragraph (may include inline 'Read more' link), optional next-draw date and jackpot paragraphs, CTA link (button)

blockContent.notes: The orange 'NEW' corner flag and the jackpot prize-bar overlay are overlays on the tile image; carry jackpot values as paragraphs and the flag as an optional short paragraph.
blockContent.description: 8 game tiles (LOTTO MAX, LOTTO 649, Proline and Proline Stadium, Get a $20 bonus!, Meet the Megas, Magic Winnings Royale, Ultimate Fire Link Triple Desert Nights, Live Casino Has Arrived!) each linking to a game/promo detail page
